workerProcesses.Name: powershell.exe
powershell.exe
workerProcesses.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -match 'python|powershell') -and ($_.CommandLine -like '*firefly_bot.main*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*worker-once*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*firefly-automation*') } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4"

previewProcesses.Name: powershell.exe
powershell.exe
previewProcesses.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*event-hub/wsServer.ts*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*wsServer.ts*' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4"
